title: IntelliJ sync fails when sandboxing is enabled

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:


If I disable sandboxing, it works fine.

Steps how to reproduce:
- Install IntelliJ IDEA CE 2016.2.
- Install "IntelliJ with Bazel" plug-in.
- Create a new Bazel project in IntelliJ:
  - Workspace is a fresh GitHub clone.
  - My project view looks like this:

```
directories:
  src
  third_party
  tools

targets:
  //src/...

test_sources:
  src/test/*
  src/tools/generate_workspace/src/test/*
  third_party/ijar/test/*
```
- Sync the project.
